I use a Grok bot called Fine Print to check any contract, lease, bill, etc and it breaks down what's actually in the paperwork.

It looks for hidden fees, catches things I might miss, and can even write a dispute or alternate terms.

Give it a try: https://t.co/KS3GaCovLP

— Dirty Tesla (@DirtyTesLa) October 14, 2026
